title: Prove exact local right-vector costs at every role count (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof: for every central field K, associative local K-algebra R, role count n>=1 and invertible target M, the paid right-vector cost is exactly the column lower bound, even with arbitrary free GL_n(K) maps anywhere.

```text
E = {v in K^n : Mv belongs to K^n}
cost(M) = delta(M) = n - dim_K(E) <= n
delta(M) = min_{T in GL_n(K)} dim_K((MT-I)K^n)

Fix E by free charts.
Permute complementary rows to obtain unit pivots.
Replace each remaining column with one legal I+u e_j^T factor.
```

The residue division algebra need not equal K or be commutative. Finite dimension and a nilpotent radical are not assumed. PROOF.md gives the construction and multiplication order. This extends #4276's two-role local theorem to arbitrary roles and settles the invertible local case left by #4265. It is a formal-alphabet result, with no new kappa, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Nick Petalas #4265/#4276/#4243 for the question, two-role theorem and free-map bound; Wentao Li #4099 following #2513 for the alphabet and column expansion; and ToikY #4334 and Nick Petalas #4601/#4749 for the distinct two-role product/semilocal comparisons. Basis extension, Gaussian elimination, Schur complements and local-ring unit lifting are classical. The new contribution is their exact arbitrary-role restricted-alphabet consequence. No predecessor verifier is imported or audited.

## Evidence

- Before: #4276 proves the local theorem only at two roles; #4265 records finite three-role binary agreement without a universal local proof. After: PROOF.md establishes the arbitrary-field, arbitrary-role theorem and an attaining word with no auxiliary roles.
- The self-contained standard-library verifier checks 2,380 distinct sampled targets at n=3,4,5 across five local algebras: binary dual numbers, a binary two-generator square-zero algebra, ternary cube-zero coefficients, F4 over F2, and noncommutative F4[e;Frobenius]/e^2 over F2. These are bounded samples, not complete target censuses.
- Every literal word and 27,616 separate basis-data executions pass. A calibration evaluates all 168 GL3(F2) charts on each of 16 targets, totaling 2,688 direct delta-chart evaluations. Eight controls distinguish factor order, omitted/changed factors, free endpoints, singular inputs, unit pivots, nilpotents and free targets.
- Both warning-strict registered commands pass locally, separately timed at 0.805 seconds ordinary and 0.806 seconds optimized. Complete generated receipts agree and bind all six package files. The package runner passes.
- Eight-file committed-byte/source-history preflight passes at `4b58e8cd5690bd35cf01b0018eefa2c39a298920`. Official committed export integrity and optimized replay from its read-only Git-free export with PATH=/nonexistent pass with the identical receipt. In-memory compilation and staged whitespace checks pass. No receipt is handwritten.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal claim rests on the written scoped proof. Executed corroboration uses F2 and F3 as base fields and the fixed samples above. Singular targets, products of local rings and nonlocal coefficient algebras are outside this theorem. Native coefficient preparation, frames, routing, restoration, precision, stock and the complete recursive invoice remain unknown. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and selected operator replay were not run; every registered package command ran locally.

## Open next questions

- Characterize simultaneous pivot flags for invertible targets at n>=3 over products of local algebras. Begin with one three-role pair over F2 x F2; the present chart and pivot order may conflict across components.
- Specify one literal native producer/consumer and its algebra-valued coefficient preparation, access, frame conversion and restoration before using a column replacement in a complete supplier bill.

## Related open work

- #4781, head `b838121c65e1bfd17a65466c95940eb00f12a225`, counts two-role singular rank-one residue lifts over field extensions. Our targets are invertible, so no target-cost count overlaps; its 567 one-factor lifts are not compared to this sample count.
- #4780, head `a4436fab4164eccc498d4d9885eec68211c869de`, studies singular rank-one tuples over nonlocal field products. Both its endpoint and coefficient-algebra hypotheses differ; no threshold or target count overlaps.
- #4776, head `0764ab259a8ce496a4c5d4debeed4c4e4d9f7ca4`, classifies singular square-zero radical pencils at arbitrary role counts. The binary square-zero coefficient algebra also occurs in our samples, but its zero-residue endpoints and our invertible endpoints are disjoint. No numerical census or cost value is asserted on a shared target.
- #4784, head `4d0a6363fe4f45dd9a769f5b74d02fc5d9061ae3`, counts invertible polynomial-target costs over F_q[t]. That ring is nonlocal and outside this theorem; no target count or cost distribution overlaps.
- #4789, head `7fdbf8040ea9a957af0576067df2d9cb6fcf0e51`, classifies singular ordinary rank-two targets over M_m(K), m>=3. Both its nonlocal matrix algebra and singular endpoints are outside this theorem; no target count or exact-cost value is asserted on a shared target.

The cited merged two-role and binary three-role predecessors retain their credit. Their finite censuses are not the deliverable here. No open PR claiming this arbitrary-role local theorem was found in the submission searches.
